## `view.map_camera`

Sets the map editor's camera: the 3D view's field of view, 50 to 150 degrees, how fast the mouse and keys move it, 0.1 to 10 times, and which way a vertical look and the wheel go. Settings not given are kept.

Parameters:

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "CameraSpeed": {
      "description": "How fast the camera moves, as a factor of the editor's own speed: 1 is that speed.",
      "format": "float",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "Direction": {
      "description": "Which way a mouse movement moves the camera.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "normal",
          "description": "The ordinary way: up looks up, the wheel away travels forward.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "inverted",
          "description": "The other way, as TrenchBroom's Invert settings.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "MapFov": {
      "description": "The 3D view's field of view across, in degrees.",
      "format": "float",
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The parameters of `view.map_camera`: the settings to change, the rest kept.",
  "properties": {
    "fly_speed": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/CameraSpeed"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "description": "How fast the keys fly it."
    },
    "fov": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/MapFov"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "description": "The 3D view's field of view, 50 to 150 degrees."
    },
    "look_speed": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/CameraSpeed"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "description": "How fast a right-drag turns the camera, 0.1 to 10 times the editor's speed."
    },
    "look_vertical": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Direction"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "description": "Which way a vertical right-drag tilts it."
    },
    "pan_speed": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/CameraSpeed"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "description": "How fast a middle-drag pans it."
    },
    "wheel": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Direction"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "description": "Which way the wheel travels it."
    }
  },
  "title": "MapCameraParams",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `view.map_keep_view`

Keeps a place and heading of the map editor's 3D view as a saved view. The window runs it for `view.map_save_view_1` to `_4`, with its camera.

Parameters:

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "ViewSlot": {
      "description": "One of the four places a view is saved in.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "1",
          "description": "The first.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "2",
          "description": "The second.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "3",
          "description": "The third.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "4",
          "description": "The fourth.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The parameters of `view.map_keep_view`.",
  "properties": {
    "origin": {
      "description": "The camera's place, in map units.",
      "items": {
        "format": "float",
        "type": "number"
      },
      "maxItems": 3,
      "minItems": 3,
      "type": "array"
    },
    "pitch": {
      "description": "Its pitch in degrees, positive looking down.",
      "format": "float",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "slot": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ViewSlot",
      "description": "The slot to save the view in."
    },
    "yaw": {
      "description": "Its yaw in degrees: 0 looks down +x, growing towards +y.",
      "format": "float",
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "slot",
    "origin",
    "yaw",
    "pitch"
  ],
  "title": "KeepViewParams",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `view.move_panel`

Moves a panel to another dock, where it shows, as Zed's status-bar menu moves one.

Parameters:

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "DockPanel": {
      "description": "One panel a dock shows.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "project",
          "description": "The project's files.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "symbols",
          "description": "The open file's symbols, or the project's.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "entities",
          "description": "The running game's entities.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "map",
          "description": "The open map's outline.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "properties",
          "description": "The selection's properties.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "agent",
          "description": "The agent.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "problems",
          "description": "The problems.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "console",
          "description": "The game's console.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "debugger",
          "description": "The debugger.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "terminal",
          "description": "The terminals.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "git",
          "description": "Git.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "Panel": {
      "description": "One of the panels around the centre (UI-2).",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "left",
          "description": "Project and Entities.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "right",
          "description": "Properties and the agent.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "bottom",
          "description": "Problems, Console and the debugger.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The parameters of `view.move_panel`.",
  "properties": {
    "dock": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Panel",
      "description": "The dock it moves to."
    },
    "panel": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/DockPanel",
      "description": "The panel."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "panel",
    "dock"
  ],
  "title": "MovePanelParams",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `view.resize_panel`

Sets the width of the left or right panel, or the height of the bottom panel, in points.

Parameters:

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "Panel": {
      "description": "One of the panels around the centre (UI-2).",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "left",
          "description": "Project and Entities.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "right",
          "description": "Properties and the agent.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "bottom",
          "description": "Problems, Console and the debugger.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The parameters of `view.resize_panel`.",
  "properties": {
    "panel": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Panel",
      "description": "The panel: `left`, `right` or `bottom`."
    },
    "size": {
      "description": "Its new width, or height for the bottom panel, in points: at least 120.",
      "format": "float",
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "panel",
    "size"
  ],
  "title": "ResizePanelParams",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `view.show_panel`

Shows a panel in its dock, opening the dock; when the dock already shows it, hides the dock, as a click on Zed's status-bar button does, unless when_shown is keep.

Parameters:

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "DockPanel": {
      "description": "One panel a dock shows.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "project",
          "description": "The project's files.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "symbols",
          "description": "The open file's symbols, or the project's.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "entities",
          "description": "The running game's entities.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "map",
          "description": "The open map's outline.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "properties",
          "description": "The selection's properties.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "agent",
          "description": "The agent.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "problems",
          "description": "The problems.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "console",
          "description": "The game's console.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "debugger",
          "description": "The debugger.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "terminal",
          "description": "The terminals.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "git",
          "description": "Git.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "WhenShown": {
      "description": "What `view.show_panel` does when the dock already shows the panel.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "hide",
          "description": "Hide the dock, as a second click on Zed's status-bar button does.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "keep",
          "description": "Keep it shown, as showing a panel for something it holds does.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The parameters of `view.show_panel`.",
  "properties": {
    "panel": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/DockPanel",
      "description": "The panel."
    },
    "when_shown": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/WhenShown",
      "default": "hide",
      "description": "What to do when its dock already shows it: hide the dock unless `keep`."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "panel"
  ],
  "title": "ShowPanelParams",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `view.toggle_panel`

Shows or hides a panel: Project and Entities on the left, Properties and the agent on the right, or Problems, Console and the debugger at the bottom.

Parameters:

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "Panel": {
      "description": "One of the panels around the centre (UI-2).",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "left",
          "description": "Project and Entities.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "right",
          "description": "Properties and the agent.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "bottom",
          "description": "Problems, Console and the debugger.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The parameters of `view.toggle_panel`.",
  "properties": {
    "panel": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Panel",
      "description": "The panel: `left` (Project and Entities), `right` (Properties and the agent) or\n`bottom` (Problems, Console and the debugger)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "panel"
  ],
  "title": "TogglePanelParams",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `view.zoom`

Draws the interface's text and icons larger or smaller, from 0.5 (50 percent) to 3 (300 percent); 1 is the actual size.

Parameters:

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "Zoom": {
      "description": "How much larger than 100 percent the interface is drawn, as a factor: 1 is 100 percent.",
      "format": "float",
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The parameters of `view.zoom`.",
  "properties": {
    "zoom": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Zoom",
      "description": "The zoom, from 0.5 (50 percent) to 3 (300 percent)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "zoom"
  ],
  "title": "ZoomParams",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `vm.run`

Builds the open project and calls one QuakeC function in the VM over a mock engine, with globals and the fields of a self edict set first, answering each global and field the call changed and any run error.

Parameters:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The parameters of `vm.run`.",
  "properties": {
    "function": {
      "description": "The function to call, by name.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "globals": {
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "default": {},
      "description": "Named globals set before the call: a number for a float, three for a vector.",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "self_fields": {
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "default": {},
      "description": "Fields of a fresh edict that `self` names during the call, set the same way; with\nnone, `self` is the world.",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "function"
  ],
  "title": "VmRunParams",
  "type": "object"
}
```
